set.body:
Follow-ups from the cold review of 4a (faede5459; fixes at 5ec21c243). None blocks landing.
F1. Negative probes in DecisionSupportUnforgeableSuite / DecisionSupportPackageAttackSuite assert only typeCheckErrors(...).nonEmpty. For apply/copy/fromProduct/Mirror on non-case classes the snippet fails by shape regardless of privacy: regression guards, not controls. Pin the "cannot be accessed" message on the new/.derived probes.
F4. Behavioural tests of UnitOutcome.categorical live in codec (and fixtures); align has only compile probes. Add align-local tests.
F5. No test for the surface-workspace refusal of a categorical record (untyped version check at surfaceworkspace.scala:484) or for the WorkspaceVoyage refusal. Decide typed refusal vs explicit handling.
F6. Support.Numerical / Support.Categorical have no structural equals/hashCode/toString (rule 8); matches sibling DecodedMass/Calibration.
F7. decision_origin column in the selection CSV (workspacesubset.scala:183) prints origin.toString only; a categorical abstention reads like a numerical one there.
F8. Scaladoc missing on SupportedSchemaVersions and the DecisionSupport object.
Done in the fix commits: B1 (selection mapping_version from the record, mutation-killed), D1 (categorical links must be Supplied, mutation-killed), F2 (universe membership test), F3 (two-policy digest test).
set.title: Step 4a follow-ups: probe controls, align-local tests, surface/voyage refusal tests, structural equality
